title: Clapcast from Claptone
author: Claptone
description: Be a part of the journey and allow Claptone to transport you to a place of sonic delights, with a mix designed to enchant outside of the club. Follow our golden masked friend and be the first to hear the new editions of the CLAPCAST tale...

extraits.texte: Soo cool to get a monthly fresh deep house mixtape. Just don't stop or my sound world is going to be insipid. Enfin un artiste qui propose du nouveau chaque mois, et du bon. Thanks.
Thank you to be connected with your fans. For me the best dj/producer of the moment. Just stay.... for us....for the music
News musics every weeks in one hour mix. Technically very good transition. Love it. Thank you.
